title: Junior Nighttime Passport Experience for Families in Charleston
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Junior Experience transforms Charleston’s history into an engaging nighttime adventure for families with children aged 5–11. This interactive walking tour invites kids to explore historic sites while participating in storytelling, solving challenges, and collecting stickers in their personal passports. Each stop is crafted to highlight kid-friendly facts and imaginative activities, ensuring that learning is both fun and memorable. Parents actively participate, guiding and celebrating their Junior walker, making it a truly shared experience. After the tour, families can enjoy a bonus activity that continues the fun beyond the streets of Charleston.

- Nighttime walking tour tailored for families with kids aged 5–11
- Interactive storytelling and hands-on activities at historic locations
- Collect stickers in personal passports while solving fun challenges
- Includes a bonus activity for continued family adventure after the tour
